steps.text: Hi! I'm Boyfriend, and I'll be showing you around Vortex Engine. This is the main menu: UP/DOWN pick, ENTER opens.
Story Mode plays the weeks in order, Freeplay any song you want, and Online lets you play against a friend.
Up here are the achievements and the mods menu, where mods are turned on and off. LEFT picks them with the keyboard.
The gear opens the options, right over the menu.
And 7 opens the editors: charts, characters, stages, weeks... Every screen with this button has a tutorial of its own!
